$comment: A commissioned website concept (repo Kashka-25/quinta-da-libelula, its own project; this site only links out). Card and page words approved by Cassidy (11 Nov 2026); the quote is from Cassidy's brief. Facts about the Quinta come from quintadalibelula.center. The live link is an unlisted preview sent to Quinta da Libélula for approval: do not merge this entry until they have agreed to it being shown publicly. Cover and previews are screenshots of the demo.
title: Quinta da Libélula
description: A concept for a new Quinta da Libélula website, an eco retreat in the hills of Coimbra, Portugal. “Don't just build a website. Create a digital sanctuary.”
portfolioDescription: A dragonfly arrives in a sunlit forest, melts into the Quinta's emblem, and is reborn as a radiant lotus dragonfly that flies into the homepage.
credits: Facts and photographs from quintadalibelula.center. Dragonfly models made with Meshy.

images.alt: The opening: an iridescent 3D dragonfly hovers in a misty, sunlit forest, under the line "In the green hills of Coimbra, something is listening."
The dragonfly melting into flowing streams of iridescent pigment, under the line "Let go of the shape you arrived in."
The pigment settled into the round Quinta da Libélula Retreats emblem in the forest, with an "Enter the Experience" button below.
After Enter: a golden lotus dragonfly rises over the homepage's misty mountains as the forest dissolves.
The homepage: "Some places invite you to visit. Others invite you to return to yourself." over a mountain valley, with the lotus dragonfly hovering beside it.
The Land: an illustrated map of the hillside at dusk with places to tap, and a card showing the domes on their wooden walkway.
